method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Chipmakers Lead Korean Stock Selloff on Yield Spike, IPO Stumble
Equities.reason: Regional equity weakness driven by a yield spike and a high-profile IPO failure highlights a risk-off move in tech/AI-linked names and shows how rising rates are transmitting into equity volatility — negative for broad risk sentiment, especially semiconductor/AI leadership.

Equities.title: U.S. bans DeepSeek from government agency systems amid AI rift with China
Equities.summary: U.S. Department of Homeland Security has banned DeepSeek-related technology from federal civilian agency IT systems.
Equities.reason: Regulatory / geopolitical restriction on an AI supplier raises adoption and sanction risk for AI platform names and reinforces investor caution on AI-linked equities and supply-chain exposure.

Equities.title: Tech Stocks Decline on AI Jitters, Dollar Falls: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Headline capturing broader market selloff tied to AI sentiment swings; represents a dominant short-term equity narrative (AI jitters driving sector-wide weakness) and weakens risk appetite.

Equities.title: SoftBank Group Credit Risk Hits 4-Year High on AI Funding Strain
Equities.reason: Rising credit risk at a major AI backer signals funding strains in the AI investment complex and raises systemic tail-risk for equities exposed to highly leveraged AI plays — negative for risk assets and sentiment.

Equities.title: South Korean data centre builder tumbles 32% on trading debut
Equities.summary: Shares in Elice sink in Seoul, adding to rising concern about AI valuations
Equities.reason: A sharp IPO debacle in an AI/infra name underlines investor skepticism around frothy AI valuations and amplifies local market stress (Korea), feeding the broader narrative of IPO/valuation risk in the AI cycle.

Equities.title: BlackRock, GIC among investors chasing Indian telecom major Jio's IPO as anchor bids top $26 billion
Equities.summary: Jio Platforms plans to raise up to $3.2 billion through an IPO, which is India's largest ever in rupee terms, but the second largest in dollar terms.
Equities.reason: Strong anchor demand for a large EM IPO signals continued investor appetite for high-quality, deal-led flows and supports EM equity issuance sentiment — modest positive for regional markets and IPO backdrop.

Equities.title: Bank Indonesia faces mounting pressure to hike after MSCI threat fuels market rout
Equities.summary: Bank Indonesia faces growing pressure to raise rates after MSCI’s threat to cut its market to standalone status triggered a rout in stocks, weakened the rupiah.
Equities.reason: MSCI-related de-rating and the prospect of policy tightening to defend index status create acute EM equity downside and currency-driven equity weakness — meaningful negative for Indonesia and a risk for EM sentiment.

Equities.title: AI debt worries spark surge in default insurance trading
Equities.summary: Volumes of credit default swaps linked to big tech groups soar as investors seek protection against boom unravelling
Equities.reason: Increased hedging via CDS on big tech signals investor concern about a potential unwind of the AI rally; it’s a cross-market indicator of rising tail-risk to large-cap tech equities.

Equities.title: Wells Fargo Says Earnings Off to Weak Start as Most Fall Short
Equities.reason: Early earnings season disappointment amplifies downside risk for equities if the trend broadens beyond idiosyncratic misses; represents fundamental earnings risk to the market.

Equities.title: Stock Pickers Burned by the AI Boom Think Their Moment Has Finally Arrived
Equities.reason: A smaller counter-narrative: active managers see buying opportunities after AI-led volatility. Lower relevance than macro/flow-driven signals but indicates potential rotational demand into unloved names.

Rates.title: China leaves loan rates steady for 17th consecutive month
Rates.reason: PBOC keeps LPR unchanged again — a steady policy stance is mildly supportive for bond prices (no tightening), but limited immediate global rates impact given the domestic focus and repeated nature of the move.

Rates.title: PBOC Rate Shift Plan Would Lower Borrowing Costs, Says Analysts
Rates.reason: Reports of a PBOC plan to lower borrowing costs point to prospective easing/reform that would be positive for bond prices (downward pressure on yields) and could ease Asian funding strains if implemented.

Rates.title: New Zealand’s Year-End Inflation Surge Points to More Rate Hikes
Rates.reason: A surge in NZ inflation that points to further RBNZ hikes is a clear negative for bond prices (pushes yields higher) and raises the regional higher-for-longer rate narrative.

Rates.title: Japan’s 20-Year Bond Auction Sees Strongest Demand on Record
Rates.reason: Record demand at a long-dated JGB auction signals strong bid for duration — bullish for bond prices (yields down) and relevant to global rates given Japan's outsized role in global fixed-income flows.

Rates.title: The Treasury’s financing plans are sparking anxiety on Wall Street
Rates.reason: Heavy anticipated Treasury issuance is a clear supply-side headwind for US Treasury prices (pressure on yields higher) and is taken seriously by market participants — meaningful for rates and term premia.

Rates.title: Treasuries Losing Luster as Hedge Tool, Citi Australia CEO Says
Rates.reason: Comments that Treasuries are less effective as a hedge imply lower demand and potentially higher yields/volatility — a negative signal for bond prices and risk management flows.

Rates.title: Fed could hike rates up to four times in 18 months, investment chief warns
Rates.reason: Public warnings that the Fed may resume hiking would lift expected terminal rates and near-term policy path — negative for bond prices (yields higher) and increases higher-for-longer risk.

Rates.title: Why hedge funds could be making a bond market shock more likely
Rates.summary: The Bank of England's deputy governor has warned that hedge funds' activities could raise the risk of a global bond market shock.
Rates.reason: Concerns about leverage and hedge fund positioning raise tail-risk for bond markets (disorderly sell-offs, higher yields and volatility) — important for risk premia and market structure in rates.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026
Rates.reason: Board minutes about discount rate meetings provide operational insight into Fed liquidity/support tools and tilt slightly negative for bond prices if they indicate a tighter policy stance or reduced backstop assumptions.

Rates.title: Ares Warns of Australian Private Credit Stress From Rising Rates
Rates.reason: Private credit stress driven by rising rates underscores the real economy and credit-channel effects of higher interest rates — a negative signal for credit spreads and for overall fixed-income sentiment.

FX.title: British Pound gains ground amid diverging Fed-BoE expectations

FX.reason: GBP/USD strength driven by USD weakness on Fed pause expectations — clear USD-centric FX move with material impact on a major pair; medium-high relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar rallies as oil prices rise, US Dollar softens
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its losses for the fourth successive day, trading around 1.4090 during Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair loses ground as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) receives support from an upside in oil prices.
FX.reason: CAD strength versus USD tied to rising oil — direct FX transmission for a commodity-linked currency; relevant for CAD flows and USD index dynamics.

FX.title: Australian Dollar holds onto gains against US Dollar, PBoC leaves rates steady
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) holds onto two-day gains at around 0.6985 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trade on Tuesday. The Aussie pair reflects strength as the US Dollar remains under pressure due to Artificial Intelligence (AI) jitters.
FX.reason: AUD/USD strength reflects broad USD softness (risk/AI jitters) and PBoC policy backdrop — a major USD pair with clear USD-transmission; standard relevance.

FX.title: Swiss Franc gains as US Dollar weakens on Fed rate pause bets
FX.summary: USD/CHF depreciates after posting modest gains the previous day, trading around 0.8250 during Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair loses ground as the US Dollar (USD) weakens under growing market expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will leave interest rate
FX.reason: CHF strength as USD softens on Fed pause bets — safe-haven and major-pair FX move; relevant to broader USD dynamics but a more modest move.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Multiple headwinds for Euro backs downside bias
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) is up 0.15% at around 1.1230 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Tuesday. The major currency pair gains as the US Dollar is under pressure ahead of Meta Q3 earnings on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Price-forecast/technical piece on EUR/USD — currently shows EUR up amid USD pressure but frames headwinds; treated as lower-relevance technical/forecast content per rules.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index weakens below 102.00 as traders assess Fed rate outlook
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 101.80 in the early European trading hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: DXY weakening is a central USD-driven development that underpins multiple pair moves — high relevance for cross-asset FX flows and market regime (USD down / risk-supportive).

FX.title: Euro holds gains above 1.1200 despite French turmoil
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair holds positive ground near 1.1215 during the early European session on Tuesday. However, the potential upside for the pair might be limited as violent protests in France add to concerns about the country's worsening fiscal outlook.
FX.reason: EUR/USD staying above 1.12 amid USD softness but domestically-driven French unrest limits upside — relevant EUR move with a clear domestic risk offset.

FX.title: Swiss Franc: Safe-haven support limits losses against Euro – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister notes that EUR/CHF has dropped to a three‑month low as the Swiss Franc (CHF) recovers its earlier weakness driven by divergent central bank expectations.
FX.reason: CHF recovery versus EUR reflects safe-haven flows and central-bank divergence; relevant to major-currency liquidity and cross-asset risk pricing, but a non-USD cross so slightly lower relevance.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains as Jakarta authorities launch stabilization measures
FX.summary: USD/IDR loses ground for the second consecutive day, trading around 18,040 during Asian hours on Tuesday. The Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) receives support as Bank Indonesia (BI) intensifies stabilization efforts under President Prabowo Subianto's directive.
FX.reason: EMFX move driven by explicit central-bank stabilization measures — relevant for EM flows and USD demand; direct FX-native central-bank action increases relevance.

FX.title: British Pound maintains its bid tone buoyed by upbeat UK unemployment figures
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) has resumed its immediate bullish trend against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, favoured by better-than-expected UK unemployment figures, although the whole employment report contains significant warnings.
FX.reason: Fundamental UK labour surprise supporting GBP vs USD — important domestic data driving a major pair; reinforces the USD-weak/GBP-strong narrative.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $57.50 despite rising inflation concerns
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground for the second successive day, trading around $57.40 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Tuesday. However, Silver prices may fall as higher oil prices boost inflation concerns and reinforce expectations of tighter monetary
Commodities.reason: Precious-metal pressure from energy-led inflation and tighter policy expectations is the dominant theme; FXStreet notes near-term gains but highlights inflation/tighter policy risk, so overall small-to-moderate negative bias for silver.

Commodities.title: Gold tumbles below $4,150 amid elevated US Treasury yields
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) falls to around $4,135 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. The precious metal extends its downside as US bond yields stayed elevated despite falling energy prices.
Commodities.reason: Clear negative transmission: elevated US Treasury yields weigh on gold. High relevance because gold is a core commodity and yields are the primary macro driver for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Gold Holds Decline as Energy-Led Inflation Weighs on Rate Path
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg frames the dominant macro narrative: energy-driven inflation lifts rate expectations and keeps gold on the defensive. High relevance due to Bloomberg's macro focus and market-moving framing.

Commodities.title: Copper is outshining gold this year. Investors say the rally can survive an AI correction
Commodities.summary: Copper is up 15.8% in 2026 as investors point to AI, grid and national security demand, tight supply and tariff-driven U.S. stockpiles.
Commodities.reason: Demand-led bullish narrative (AI, grid, national security) and tight supply underpin a positive copper outlook; relevance is material given copper's industrial role and the structural demand theme.

Commodities.title: WTI rebounds toward $98.50 as traders weigh escalating conflicts
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price gains ground after registering modest loses in previous day, trading around $98.40 per barrel during Asian hours on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical escalation is supporting WTI prices and sustaining a risk premium; positive directional impact with high relevance because oil supply risk is a primary market driver.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Potential Gulf production shut‑ins raise near-term supply risks for oil and gas; positive for prices but regional and event‑specific, so medium relevance.

Commodities.title: Natural Gas retests $3.00 support after double top: Live levels
Commodities.reason: Technical note showing natural gas testing support; lower relevance because this is price-level/technical analysis rather than a major fundamental shock.

Commodities.title: Iran war tilts balance of global oil power towards Americas
Commodities.summary: Countries from Canada to Argentina have seen surge in investment and production as buyers rush to replace supply lost to Hormuz disruption
Commodities.reason: Medium-term structural shift: increased Americas production reduces global oil supply vulnerability and could relieve price pressure over time; this is a meaningful counter-signal to near-term geopolitical risk, so moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
Crypto.reason: Large quarterly hack losses are a direct negative for crypto market confidence and institutional participation; security failures increase regulatory and counterparty risk, weighing on prices and flows.

Crypto.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
Crypto.reason: Major payment networks integrating crypto rails materially boost on‑ramps and real‑world utility for stablecoins/crypto, supporting adoption and institutional interest despite supply headwinds.

Crypto.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin, representing dollar deposits, to Ethereum
Crypto.reason: A major bank deploying a dollar-representative coin on a public smart‑contract platform is a significant institutional adoption signal, improving settlement/tapi rails and legitimizing on‑chain dollars.

Crypto.title: Crypto vault deposits top $10 billion as lending risks draw regulatory scrutiny
Crypto.reason: Rising vault/custody flows show flight to perceived safety but the accompanying regulatory scrutiny of lending heightens counterparty and regulatory risk for crypto credit markets — net negative.

Crypto.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
Crypto.reason: Regulatory pushback on major derivatives venue legal posture creates uncertainty for perpetuals/liquidity and could raise compliance costs or reduce product availability — negative for trading activity.

Crypto.title: Tether: Senator's investigation misses positive work that's led to lower Iran volumes
Crypto.reason: Ongoing political investigations into a major stablecoin issuer raise regulatory and reputational risks; effect is modestly negative given mixed evidence in the piece.

Crypto.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
Crypto.reason: Large incumbent bank expanding custody services signals growing institutional infrastructure and demand for secure custody, a constructive development for crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Crypto exchanges Binance, Coinbase join West Africa scam sweep that flagged $11 million
Crypto.reason: Active participation by major exchanges in anti‑scam law enforcement supports compliance narrative and reduces illicit-flow concerns, a modest positive for regulatory acceptance.

Crypto.title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
Crypto.reason: Departure of a senior crypto policy official increases short‑term regulatory uncertainty and could slow coordination on policy, a modest negative for the regulatory outlook.

Crypto.title: Zerohash rolls out a new tool to move crypto without copying wallet addresses
Crypto.reason: UX/operational improvement that reduces user error and friction; positive for on‑chain usability but limited market impact.
